description: This file defines an Android activity called PlayerActivity which manages an immersive video playback screen using ExoPlayer. It handles media URL intent extras, UI setup including full-screen mode, custom controls with animations, and lifecycle management for media playback.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for immersive media playback with custom controls and full-screen experience, leveraging ExoPlayer

methods.name: PlayerActivity.newIntent
methods.description: Constructs an Intent to launch PlayerActivity with media URL, optional title, and poster
